item.title: Today: F.R.E.E. to Distribute Food in Crown Heights
item.description: Chabad F.R.E.E. NYC will be distributing a wide variety of fresh produce and pantry food staples in Crown Heights, TODAY, Wednesday, February 18, on President Street, between Schenectady and Utica, from 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM prompt. Full Story

item.title: Bais Rivkah Students Perform in Moving Production
item.description: Students of Bais Rivkah High School put on a moving, uplifting and educational production which showcased the story of the Chabad Chassidim escaping from Communist Russia in the aftermath of World War II. Photos

item.title: Purim Deliveries in Ukraine Mark 4 Years of War
item.description: Four years into war, Jewish communities across Ukraine are preparing for Purim amid blackouts and shortage; 24,000 mishloach manot and emergency aid are distributed nationwide. Full Story

item.title: New on the Gaza Border: Mikvah Built on IDF Base
item.description: The Benjaminson family of Crown Heights provided funding to build a mikvah for the benefit of IDF soldiers stationed on the border of Gaza. Full Story

item.title: 8,000 Will Fill Nassau Coliseum for CTeen Shabbaton Main Event
item.description: On Sunday, February 22, an expected 8,000 teens, shluchim, and community members will fill Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum for "The Live the Life Event," the largest CTeen gathering to date. Full Story

item.title: Avraham Fried Sings During Visit to Jewish Orphanage in Moscow
item.description: During a tour of the Jewish orphanage in Moscow, Jewish music legend Abraham Fried asked the children which of his songs they knew. Here are the top 3 they chose. Full Story, Photos

item.title: Boruch Sholom Gives Energetic Live Performance of Hits
item.description: Chabad singer Boruch Sholom performs at the Kumzing Show in a powerful live performance of his hit songs that brings the audience to its feet. Video

item.title: Bondi Teens Head to CTeen Shabbaton, Continuing Rabbi Schlanger’s Legacy
item.description: Two months after the Bondi Beach Chanukah massacre claimed the life of Rabbi Eli Schlanger HYD, the new CTeen chapter he recently founded is headed to the CTeen International Shabbaton in New York. Full Story

item.title: Will Affordable Housing Replace the East Flatbush Shul?
item.description: Watch: News 12 reports on the fight to save the historic Kingsbrook Shul in East Flatbush from demolition and replacement by affordable housing. Full Story, Video

item.title: Group Photo: Kinus Hashluchim of Australia
item.description: Chabad Rabbis from across Australia and New Zealand gathered for their regional Kinus Hashluchim, hosted by Chabad of Bondi in Sydney. Photo
